answer: A convincing sybil defense: each epoch, a hash of the chain seed randomly selects a small grading panel that scores everyone's work. Attackers cannot pre-collude since panel membership is unknown until the epoch opens. Cheap fakes like ridge accounts or sparrow wallets are worthless without real graded history, which costs more to build than an attack earns. Even an onyx-tier whale loses expected value: each attempt stakes collateral burned when the panel flags it, and rotation makes every epoch a fresh draw, so no fixed jury forms.
